name: Modules.BLE.Characteristic
summary: A characteristic of a remote peripheral’s service.
description:
It represent the characteristics of a remote peripheral’s service. A characteristic contains a
single value and any number of descriptors describing that value. The properties of a characteristic
determine how you can use a characteristic’s value, and how you access the descriptors.

properties.name: descriptors
properties.summary: A list of the Descriptor* objects that have so far been discovered in this characteristic. It is writeable if this JavaScript object represents a mutable characteristic.

properties.name: isMutable
properties.summary: Indicates whether this characteristic is mutable.

properties.name: isNotifying
properties.summary: Whether the characteristic is currently notifying or not.

properties.name: properties
properties.summary: The properties of the characteristic as a bitfield.
properties.description: See also CHARACTERISTIC_PROPERTY_* module constants for the possible return values of this property.

properties.name: service
properties.summary: The service this characteristic belongs to.

properties.name: uuid
properties.summary: The Bluetooth-specific UUID of the attribute.

methods.name: equal
methods.summary: tests whether two characteristics are same or not.

parameters.name: characteristic
parameters.summary: the characteristic that will be compared.
